project_existing_bvbrc_adapter.scope: Separate public data adapter for genome/genome_feature/protein_family_ref with api.bvbrc.query and api.bvbrc.result; not upstream MCP AppService/Workspace integration. Historical public retrieval evidence is described in launch_instruction_library/api-bvbrc.md, not reverified here.

registered_tools.name: bvbrc_search_data
registered_tools.description: Unified natural-language data search tool for BV-BRC.
registered_tools.actual_operation: LLM selects one collection; tokenized AND Solr search, cursor pagination; count/facet branch. advanced is unconditionally reset to False.
registered_tools.resource: BV-BRC api-bulk plus configured LLM; local post-processing
registered_tools.auth_requirements: Optional token for public data, needed for protected data; HTTP MCP endpoint itself uses OAuth. Configured LLM required.
registered_tools.native_or_return_result_type: JSON envelope with TSV string/count/pagination; count-only numeric JSON; facets JSON plus TSV. Underlying Solr rows are structured JSON.
registered_tools.grader_disposition: retrieval_reader_candidate; preserve record assertions and raw numbers, no blanket scientific score

registered_tools.name: get_sra_metadata
registered_tools.description: Retrieve metadata for one or more SRA (Sequence Read Archive) IDs.
registered_tools.actual_operation: Runs singularity exec <container> p3-sra --metaonly once per run ID, then parses local metadata JSON.
registered_tools.resource: MCP server local Singularity command fetching SRA metadata; no HPC binding
registered_tools.auth_requirements: No tool-level BV-BRC token argument; HTTP endpoint uses OAuth; configured container and Singularity needed.
registered_tools.native_or_return_result_type: JSON results per SRA ID: success, metadata, error; requested/success/failed totals.
registered_tools.grader_disposition: metadata_reader_candidate; metadata lookup is not an analysis result

registered_tools.name: create_feature_group
registered_tools.description: Create a feature group in the workspace.
registered_tools.actual_operation: Rewrites feature ID punctuation before Workspace.create feature_group. Four-digit suffix IDs can be corrupted.
registered_tools.native_or_return_result_type: Workspace object metadata wrapped in JSON data/source or error.

registered_tools.name: create_genome_group
registered_tools.description: Create a genome group in the workspace.
registered_tools.actual_operation: Workspace.create genome_group containing supplied genome_id list.
registered_tools.native_or_return_result_type: Workspace object metadata wrapped in JSON data/source or error.

registered_tools.name: get_feature_group_ids

registered_tools.grader_disposition: group membership retrieval; no scientific grade

registered_tools.name: get_genome_group_ids

registered_tools.name: get_job_details
registered_tools.description:
Query task details by task IDs. Use this tool for questions about specific jobs, such as:
- Why did a job fail?
- What happened during job execution?
- What is the current status of a job?
- What were the job parameters or results?
- Debugging job issues or errors
registered_tools.actual_operation: Calls AppService.query_tasks; optionally GETs last 100 stdout/stderr lines per task.
registered_tools.resource: BV-BRC AppService API and task_info HTTP
registered_tools.native_or_return_result_type: JSON {data:<native task records>,source}; optional log strings, error object.
registered_tools.grader_disposition: operational state/log reader; no scientific grade

registered_tools.name: get_service_submission_schema
registered_tools.description:
Fetch the authoritative submission schema for one service.
Use the helpdesk tool for any other guidance or questions about which service to run.
registered_tools.actual_operation: Reads prompts/services/<name>.txt and appends an output-path note; does not query a live authoritative schema.
registered_tools.auth_requirements: Requires BV-BRC token even though the implementation reads local files.
registered_tools.native_or_return_result_type: Plain parameter-guidance text or error string.

registered_tools.name: health_check
registered_tools.actual_operation: Returns fixed health text; no backend checks.

registered_tools.name: list_jobs
registered_tools.description: List jobs (summary view) with sorting/filtering support.
registered_tools.actual_operation: AppService.enumerate_tasks_filtered with filters/sort; removes deleted jobs.

registered_tools.name: list_service_apps
registered_tools.description: List available BV-BRC service apps that can be submitted.
registered_tools.actual_operation: Calls AppService.enumerate_apps then maps app IDs; wrapper mistakenly requires a list after helper wraps result in a dict.
registered_tools.auth_requirements: BV-BRC token required; HTTP OAuth or stdio KB_AUTH_TOKEN/explicit token.
registered_tools.native_or_return_result_type: Advertised service list; actual successful helper response yields {services:[],count:0,source}. Declares str but returns dict.

registered_tools.name: plan_workflow
registered_tools.description: Plan and persist a workflow from natural language without executing it.
registered_tools.actual_operation: Configured LLM selects services and generates manifest; configured workflow engine may persist it. Service-catalog discovery unwrap is defective.
registered_tools.resource: Configured LLM + AppService catalog + external workflow-engine API
registered_tools.auth_requirements: BV-BRC token, configured LLM, engine for persistence.
registered_tools.native_or_return_result_type: JSON workflow_id,status,persisted,workflow_json,step_count,warnings. Local fallback ID can be labelled persisted=true by wrapper.
registered_tools.grader_disposition: upstream orchestration helper; outside deterministic tool graders and this project episode ownership

registered_tools.name: read_file_bytes_tool
registered_tools.description: Read a byte window from local session files or workspace files.

registered_tools.name: read_file_lines
registered_tools.description: Read line ranges from a local Copilot session file.

registered_tools.grader_disposition: generic deterministic reader only; scientific schema and calculations belong elsewhere

registered_tools.name: submit_workflow
registered_tools.description: Submit an already planned workflow for execution.
registered_tools.actual_operation: Health-checks configured workflow engine then POSTs /workflows/<id>/submit; does not call local start_* functions.

registered_tools.native_or_return_result_type: JSON workflow ID/status/submission time/status URL or structured engine error; no scientific result bytes.

registered_tools.name: workspace_browse_tool
registered_tools.description: Find and list files in the user's personal workspace by name, type, or extension.

registered_tools.native_or_return_result_type: JSON result with items or metadata, count, result_type, call and ui_grid.

registered_tools.name: workspace_download_file_tool

registered_tools.native_or_return_result_type: JSON data containing UTF-8 text or tagged base64; optional saved-file message.
registered_tools.grader_disposition: artifact transport; pass retained scientific files to their own native readers

registered_tools.name: workspace_upload

registered_tools.resource: BV-BRC Workspace/storage API plus local file read
registered_tools.auth_requirements: BV-BRC token and existing local file.

registered_tools.native_or_return_result_type: JSON retrieved documents with relevance scores/content/metadata, summary, count; may contain summary_error.

source_issues_and_gaps.finding: list_service_apps expects list but enumerate_apps always wraps data in dict; returns zero apps even on nonempty native response.
Same list/dict mismatch empties build_service_catalog. generate_workflow_with_services receives no detailed selected-service specs; this does not prove every plan fails.
bvbrc_search_data unconditionally sets advanced=False, so advertised structured query and sequence-mode branch are unreachable.
create_feature_group inserts a dot before last three characters if missing there, corrupting otherwise valid four-digit feature suffixes.

Internal planning assigns wf_local fallback plus warnings; outer plan_workflow sets persisted=True whenever any ID is returned and drops generated warnings. A local ID can be represented as persisted/saved.
get_service_submission_schema reads local prose prompt text, not a live schema. Some prose differs from handler signatures (genome_annotation recipie typo).
list_publication_datasets is not registered and its helper has TODO logic returning an empty list.
47 manifest names are not equivalent to active tools: only 10 overlap. All 31 service-related manifest names are not individual exposed tools.
Service reverse map chooses HASubtypeNumberingConversion while config mapping/start handler use InfluenzaHASubtypeConversion; live compatibility unverified.
bins_directory output template points to BinningReport.html; does not identify a bins directory or native bin sequences.
submit_workflow invokes an external engine by workflow ID. The local SERVICE_MAP/SPECIAL_API_SERVICES are never called for submission. Source presence does not prove backend execution availability.
STDIO main calls async initialize_service_catalog without awaiting; separate from its unwrap defect.
workspace_upload creates workspace object and actually PUTs local file bytes, beyond docstring claim of creating URL.

offline_checks.method: AST extraction of original functions with fake API/token and fake group writer; no upstream import/startup or external service

verification_limits: Source-level registration and dispatch inventory; no server launched, no package installation, no authentication, no job submission or service-result downloads.
Native result artifact patterns are upstream templates, not observed files. File names/extensions do not prove detailed schemas or existing parser compatibility.
All 31 service families accounted for, but only 28 produce/preprocess scientific analyses; date, expression_import and sequence_submission are helpers.
No local/HPC scientific algorithm execution binding is provided by this MCP checkout; its SRA metadata command and local file readers are actual local helper paths.
Existing public-data adapter is separate from authenticated AppService/Workspace; source availability and historical receipts do not establish current working access.
